limitations: No stable net end-to-end improvement established; all new hotset candidates remain explicit opt-ins.
Final source hashes describe final runtime, not every earlier screening binary. Every run has its own EXE hash.
First-request outlier in final control is retained and must not establish a seed speedup. No old-driver A/B.
Demand and epoch bytes must be added; frequency coverage alone does not measure avoided expensive GPU cold supply.
Ordinary trace host intervals overlap/nest and are not device timings; epoch cost lies outside forward spans.
32 GiB is host pool, not process RAM. No full-model event profiling, HTTP/MTP certification, or longer QSA-context validation.
Earlier screening and flawed phase-boundary prototypes are retained with explicit notes; heterogeneous prompts have no pooled warm median.
